scope: Site-level registry for finding game asset sources with AI.
notes: This registry summarizes site-level tendencies and cautions, not guarantees about individual assets.
Always verify the current terms, license, and usage conditions on the source site and on the specific asset page before use.

sources.name: Kenney
sources.license_summary: Known for broadly reusable game asset packs, but the current pack page and site terms should still be checked before release.
cautions: Confirm the current terms on the pack page before shipping.
Some packs are intentionally simple and may need extra polish for a final commercial presentation.

sources.name: Quaternius
sources.license_summary: Often used as a permissive source for low-poly 3D assets, but users should verify the latest terms for the specific download.
cautions: Validate the current license text on the asset page or site before release.
Asset variety is focused on the creator's low-poly style rather than photoreal or mixed styles.

sources.name: Poly Haven
sources.license_summary: Commonly presented as a highly permissive source, but users should still confirm the current site license for their intended use.
cautions: Best suited to realistic rendering workflows rather than stylized game packs.
Verify the current license statement if the project has strict legal review requirements.

sources.name: Sketchfab
sources.license_summary: License and download terms vary widely by listing, creator, and plan. Commercial use and redistribution must be checked per asset.
cautions: This is a community-driven platform, so license, quality, and download availability differ per asset.
Do not assume a downloadable model is commercially usable without checking the specific asset page.

sources.name: ambientCG
sources.license_summary: Often used for permissive material downloads, but users should verify the latest site license and any current restrictions.
cautions: The focus is materials and HDRIs, not full game-ready prop packs.
Confirm the current license text if legal certainty is important.

sources.name: Freesound
sources.license_summary: Licenses vary per upload, so commercial use, attribution, and redistribution must be confirmed on each sound page.
cautions: This is a community-upload platform, so license and recording quality differ significantly between sounds.
Always review the exact license on the individual sound page before use.

sources.name: Mixkit
sources.license_summary: The site is often used for free stock assets, but permitted use and restrictions should be checked against the current terms for the relevant category.
cautions: Asset categories may have different usage expectations, so confirm the current terms for the exact item type.
Coverage is broader than game assets specifically, so search intent may need tightening.

sources.name: Zapsplat
sources.license_summary: Usage terms may depend on account level or plan, so commercial use and attribution requirements must be checked against the current site terms.
cautions: Attribution and allowed use can depend on the current plan or membership level.
Do not assume all downloads have the same obligations; confirm before shipping.

sources.name: OpenGameArt
sources.license_summary: Licenses vary by submission, so commercial use, attribution, and redistribution must be confirmed on each asset page.
cautions: This is a community-submitted site, so consistency in style, quality, and licensing is limited.
Always read the exact license attached to the selected asset.

sources.name: Mixamo
sources.license_summary: Widely used for rigged characters and animations, but the current Adobe and service-specific terms should be reviewed for the intended pipeline.
cautions: Best aligned with humanoid character animation workflows rather than general-purpose prop sourcing.
Review the latest service terms, especially for redistribution and pipeline-specific restrictions.

sources.name: Piskel
sources.license_summary: This is primarily a creation tool rather than an asset source catalog, so usage questions usually relate to assets you create or import yourself.
cautions: Treat this as a pixel-art workflow tool, not a broad marketplace of ready-made assets.
Imported or third-party assets used inside the tool keep their own original license obligations.

sources.name: Aseprite
sources.license_summary: This is primarily a pixel-art editor rather than a site for browsing ready-made asset libraries.
cautions: Treat this as asset creation software, not a distribution catalog.
Any third-party assets used with the tool remain subject to their own licenses.

sources.name: itch.io Game Assets
sources.license_summary: Terms, pricing, attribution, and commercial use vary by seller and listing, so every asset page must be checked individually.
cautions: This is a marketplace with creator-specific terms, so there is no single site-wide license assumption for assets.
Quality, support expectations, and permitted use can differ significantly from one listing to another.
